description: Servo-U ventilator Edi waveform OCR engine (resolution-independent; frames normalized to 1280x720). v1.3: waveform points are chosen from the vertical extent of the trace in each column (globally optimal path with peak/valley tips preserved), removing false spikes at steep transitions; Flow scale fit excludes steep segments. v1.4: abnormal frames (pop-ups) are detected in initial_ocr from in-memory frames (Frames.csv column Abnormal); post-processing reads only the frames used for waveform extraction (engine_api 3); frame counts follow GS.FPS (engine_api 2).
